title: Julie Collins — Bills — 2023-02-09
speaker: Julie Collins
snippet: The government publicly consulted on the package from 19 December 2022 to 11 January 2023. Forty-six written submissions were received, and three consultation sessions held (two with state and territory officials, and one with community housing providers).
